capabilities: Validate note properties against manifest schemas in a schemas folder
Auto-fix missing or invalid properties on save, on open, and vault-wide
Apply conditional rules with set, add, remove, and js verbs
Edit properties through a typed field picker modal
Reorder properties and inherit manifests down folder trees
extras: Rules can also live in shared rules.md files and cascade through the manifest inheritance chain; linked-note re-checking can be disabled in settings.
problem: Obsidian offers no way to declare what a note's properties should contain or to enforce and repair that structure across many notes.
summary: Manifest-driven validator that checks note properties against schema files, auto-fills missing values, and applies conditional rules to keep metadata correct.
